evals.prompt: Our landing page has a 12MB autoplaying hero video (single 1080p MP4) and Lighthouse says LCP is 6 seconds. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: A fix that adds an optimized poster (treated as the LCP), streams or heavily compresses the loop (audio stripped, WebM+MP4 or HLS), keeps muted/playsinline autoplay, reserves layout space, adds prefers-reduced-motion fallback, and verifies with the network waterfall.
expectations: Adds or fixes the poster and treats it as the LCP element
Strips audio and re-encodes or moves to adaptive streaming instead of one large MP4
Keeps muted autoplay loop playsinline semantics
Verifies with network waterfall or Lighthouse after the change

evals.prompt: We have 14 YouTube embeds on our docs pages and they make every page slow. What should we do?
evals.expected_output: Facade pattern: thumbnail + play button, real iframe injected on click (lite-youtube-embed or equivalent), below-fold embeds load nothing at page load, preconnect on interaction, verified by network transfer before/after.
expectations: Recommends click-to-load facades rather than eager iframes
Mentions an existing component like lite-youtube-embed where dependencies are acceptable
Ensures zero video bytes load for below-fold embeds at page load

evals.prompt: Should I use a video or a 360 spin for the rotating shots of our furniture products on Sirv?
evals.expected_output: A comparison that recommends converting rotating product videos to Sirv 360 spins for interactivity and weight, using video2spin, while keeping video for demos with narrative, and pointing at the sirv-360-spin skill for implementation.
expectations: Recommends spins for rotating product views and explains why
Mentions video2spin conversion with frame count guidance
References the sirv-360-spin skill or spin workflow for implementation
